description: This file defines the Catalyst controller class for managing recipes within the Coocook application. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, duplicating, deleting, and importing recipes, as well as handling related ingredients and dishes.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Recipe
classes.description: Catalyst controller class for recipe management, extending 'Coocook::Controller'.

methods.name: submenu
methods.description: Sets up submenu items for recipe-related navigation.

methods.name: recipes
methods.description: Fetches and prepares a list of recipes for display.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Default index action for recipes; currently empty, relies on chained method.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Loads a specific recipe by ID into the stash for further actions.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Prepares data for editing a specific recipe, including ingredients and dishes.

methods.name: new_recipe
methods.description: Displays the form for creating a new recipe.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new ingredient to a recipe.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new recipe based on submitted parameters.

methods.name: from_dish
methods.description: Creates a recipe from an existing dish.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing recipe with new data.

methods.name: reposition
methods.description: Repositions an ingredient within a recipe.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Private method to handle redirection after actions.

methods.name: importable_recipes
methods.description: Lists recipes that can be imported from other projects.

methods.name: check_value
methods.description: Placeholder for value validation, currently empty.

methods.name: get_all_ajax
methods.description: Provides recipe data in JSON format for AJAX requests.
